senses.gloss: pr. n. m. (prob. Πτολεμαῖος, or Εὐπτόλεμος = Εὐπόλεμος) Abtolmos.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 3:4">Erub. III, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Eruvin 35a:13">35ᵃ</cite>) ed. (Ms. M. <he>אבטולס</he>). Ib. 36ᵃ; Y. ib. 21ᵃ bot. <he>אבטילס</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. Erub. l. c., notes).
